learning_outcomes.text: Description of basic concepts, theories and methods of mathematics, physics, chemistry, suitable for the field of electrical engineering
Operation with fundamental concepts in electrical engineering

Description of the operating principles of transformers, static, electromechanical converters, electrical equipment, the main sources of electromagnetic disturbances, as well as standards on electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of electrical and electronic equipment

syllabus_topics: Chapter 2. ELECTROMAGNETIC FIELD IN ELECTROSTATIC REGIME
Chapter 3. ELECTROMAGNETIC FIELD IN ELECTROCINETIC REGIME
Chapter 4. MAGNETIC FIELD IN AIR AND SUBSTANCE
Chapter 5. MAGNETIC ENERGY AND MAGNETIC FORCES
Presentation of the topic and the laboratory. Instructions for work safety technique
Measurement of voltage, current. Resistors in series and parallel.
Circuit series - parallel. Kirchoff I and II theorem.
Program for the recovery of laboratory work and verification of the acquired concepts
teaching_methods: Lab work with theoretical test and practical part under teacher guidance

assessment_methods.method: Academic seminar (Free presentation with interactive discussion)

assessment_rules: The final exam grade is calculated as Nfe = 0.8 * Nse + 0.1 * Nla + 0.1 * Nse, where Nla > 5. Minimum conditions for passing the course exam (grade 5) require 1pt for ex officio attendance and 4pt for 4 medium-level subjects. For the academic seminar, solving proposed problems is required for a grade of 10. For the laboratory, a grade of 5 requires meeting minimum performance standards, and a grade of 10 includes 1pt ex officio attendance and 9pt for 9 medium-level subjects.
